lyrics_sung_lines:
Okay Welcome to the tutorial level of Echoes in my blood, in here you will learn the essentials before going into the game. 
are you ready? because the first gates are approaching.
Move left and right through them.
Good job! you made it, But watch out more gates but this time you need to jump and slide over or under them.
Go! 
Alright you're really good at this, but whats this? a wall jump section!
Jump from platform to platform! and GO!

Okay almost done buddy just one last section, rail grinding and tunneling
This will require holding the designated button and mashing the jump button on a rail,
For a tunnel holding the same designated button and move through the hoops.
Ready? Go!

Alright that concludes the tutorial, enjoy the First demo of Echoes in my blood
